notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello, I have prepared a new build for the Steam Next Fest! This version adds a new character: The Monk! and addresses many pain points of the demo.

With five characters in the roster, parties should feel  a lot more varied.

Features

 New playable character: The Monk!
 New music
 New environmental sounds
 Background NPCs


Adjustments

 Losing in "The Test" no longer results in a game over.
 Sprites now appear shinier than before.


Fixes

 Multiple typos in tutorials and events.
 Some predictions were not being calculated correctly.
 You can no longer gain an alarm clock in the tutorial, which previously caused a soft lock.
